name: Stacklist
description: Search, browse, and curate stacks and cards directly from Claude. Create new stacks, add items with auto-enriched metadata, and share them publicly. Use AI-powered tools to analyze your content, generate summaries and FAQs, check discoverability, and get improvement suggestions. Manage your profile, workspaces, and featured stacks — all without leaving the conversation. Make Stacklist a native part of your AI workflow for effortless content curation and discovery.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Stacklist to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Stacklist to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://stacky.stacklist.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Stacklist MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stacklist lists 37 MCP tools, including add_cards, add_stack_to_workspace, analyze_content, auto_tag_cards, capsule, check_ai_discoverability, create_stack, describe_surfaces, enrich, enrich_batch, enrich_card_images, and generate_faq.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Stacklist?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Stacklist in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Stacklist requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Stacklist is developed by Stacklist. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
